hardware: Intel Core i7-12700H, 16 GB RAM, Windows 11; NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU, 610.91, 6144 MiB; plugged in, OMEN performance mode, Windows best performance, lid open

proposals.statement: Parents struggle to get school information because fee statements are printed and sent home in learners' bags but half never reach parents

evidence.quote: Fee statements are printed every month and sent home in the learners' bags, and half of them never reach the parents.

proposals.statement: Reports are printed, put in envelopes, and sent home but for 900 learners, this takes a week of admin staff time every term

evidence.quote: For about 900 learners, that's a week of the admin staff's time every term.

proposals.statement: Notices like sports fixtures or school closures are sent via WhatsApp broadcast lists and email but parents who change numbers fall off the lists

evidence.quote: Those go on WhatsApp broadcast lists and by email. But a broadcast list fills up, so we have five of them now, and parents who change their numbers just fall off.

proposals.statement: Absence notes are handwritten in the learner's homework diary or emailed to the class teacher who may not pass them to the office, causing issues like a learner being marked absent for three days without the office knowing

evidence.quote: Handwritten in the learner's homework diary or an email to the class teacher, who may or may not pass it on to the office. We had a learner marked absent for three days last term and nobody at the office knew why.

proposals.statement: The portal must allow parents to see their current balance, monthly fee statements as PDFs, and reference numbers for EFT payments

evidence.quote: The current balance, the monthly statement as a PDF, and the reference to use for EFT.

proposals.statement: The portal must provide term reports as PDFs released on the same day for all parents, with no early access

evidence.quote: The term report as a PDF, the same one we print. Released on the same day for everyone.

proposals.statement: The portal must allow parents to report their child's absence with reasons and dates, visible to both the class teacher and office

evidence.quote: The reason and the dates, and the class teacher and the office both see it straight away.

proposals.statement: Schoolbase 7 from about 2014 is used for learner records, fees, and marks, and can export to CSV and produce report PDFs

evidence.quote: It holds the learners, the parents fees and marks. It can export to CSV and it produces the report PDFs.

proposals.statement: The portal must be lightweight with small pages and PDFs only downloaded when opened to accommodate parents with limited data plans

evidence.quote: The portal has to be light, small pages, and the PDFs only downloaded when someone actually opens one.

proposals.statement: The portal should use the school's maroon color instead of a generic blue

evidence.quote: Oh, and please use the school's maroon, not some generic blue.

proposals.statement: The portal should have big, clear text and be accessible to users with visual impairments, including screen readers

evidence.quote: And big, clear text. Some of our parents struggle with their eyesight, and we have a blind parent on the PTA who uses a screen reader.

proposals.statement: The portal should support Isi Zulu for notices and main screens to accommodate grandparents who are more comfortable in Isi Zulu

evidence.quote: English is the school's language, but a lot of our grandparents look after the children, and they're more comfortable in Isi Zulu.

proposals.statement: The finance committee has proposed 250,000 rand for the first year, but the board must approve it by January 28th

evidence.quote: The finance committee has proposed 250,000 rand for the first year all in, but the board has to approve it, and they only meet on the 28th of January.

proposals.statement: The data must be hosted in South Africa as per the board's requirement

evidence.quote: The board said it must be hosted in South Africa. That came out of the last board meeting.

proposals.statement: Only a learner's own parents or guardians may see information about that learner, with court orders affecting about a dozen files

evidence.quote: Only a learner's own parents or guardians may see anything about that learner.
And with some divorced parents, one of them may not see anything at all. There's a court order on about a dozen files.

proposals.statement: The portal should use Isi Zulu for notices and main screens to accommodate grandparents who are more comfortable in that language

evidence.quote: English is the school's language, but a lot of our grandparents look after the children, and they're more comfortable in Isi Zulu. If the notices and the main screens could be in Isi Zulu too, that would mean a lot.

proposals.statement: The portal should have big, clear text for parents with vision difficulties and support for screen readers

evidence.quote: big, clear text. Some of our parents struggle with their eyesight, and we have a blind parent on the PTA who uses a screen reader.

proposals.statement: The portal should use the school's maroon color instead of generic blue

evidence.quote: please use the school's maroon, not some generic blue.

proposals.statement: The finance committee has proposed 250,000 rand for the first year all in, but the board must approve it by 28th January

evidence.quote: finance committee has proposed 250,000 rand for the first year all in, but the board has to approve it, and they only meet on the 28th of January.

proposals.statement: The portal should allow parents to receive term two reports by the 26th of June

evidence.quote: The term two reports go out on the 26th of June. We'd like parents to get those through the portal.

proposals.statement: The school has 1,650 parent contacts, with many families including both parents and grandparents

evidence.quote: It's not 1,400 parent contacts. It's about 1,650. A lot of families have both parents and a grandparent listed.

proposals.statement: If the first report day goes poorly, parents may lose trust in the portal immediately

evidence.quote: A risk I see is that if the first report day goes badly, parents lose trust in the portal straight away.

proposals.statement: The trial should start with grade 8 term one reports in April

evidence.quote: Let's do grade 8 in April as the trial.

proposals.statement: The school has only one IT person who works two days a week, so there's no one to fix issues on report night

evidence.quote: I'm the only IT person and only two days a week. If something breaks on report night, there's nobody.

proposals.statement: Booking slots for parents' evenings is planned for later but not in the first version

evidence.quote: Eventually, booking slots for parents' evenings. But not now.
